FIELDS.NAME: TechStop Electronics & Repair
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At TechStop Electronics & Repair, we specialize in retailing a wide range of electronic devices and accessories, along with providing professional repair services for various electronics. Our operations include the sale of consumer electronics such as smartphones, laptops, tablets, and audio equipment from our well-equipped storefront located in a bustling commercial area, ensuring high foot traffic and easy accessibility for customers. 

In addition to retailing, we offer expert repair services for damaged or malfunctioning electronics, performed by our trained technicians who adhere to industry standards. We have established a robust inventory management system to effectively track products and repair orders, allowing for smooth operations and timely service delivery. Customer service is a priority, backed by documented policies to ensure inquiries, warranty claims, and service follow-ups are handled efficiently. 

To protect our business, we have implemented security measures, including a monitored alarm system, and maintain compliance with all local zoning, health, and safety regulations. Our operations are designed to create a welcoming shopping experience while ensuring the safety and satisfaction of our customers.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any restricted activities and confirms that it has operated at the current insured location for over three years. We have installed a central alarm system with monitoring, and we derive more than 75% of our total revenue from in-store sales. Additionally, we do not rent out equipment, ensuring our operations remain fully compliant.
